keys.swarm.aura_death_mark_desc: You mark the nearby monster with the most current health. It takes double damage. Unless it is a boss, it is executed below 20% health.
keys.swarm.aura_death_mark_up: More frequent marks and an execution threshold that rises to 35%.
keys.swarm.aura_death_mark_ten: Reaper's List: a scythe falls on up to five marked targets at once.
keys.swarm.aura_shuriken_storm_desc: Shurikens are thrown ahead and stick in the ground, spinning there as saw traps.
keys.swarm.aura_shuriken_storm_ten: Star Storm: a field of 8 spinning stars.
